scenarios.title: An exhaust ability can be activated only once
decisions: A, with priority in the main phase, considers activating Afterburner Expert's exhaust ability {2}{G}{G}.

variants.label: first_activation
variants.expected: Activating the exhaust ability is legal; if activated and resolved, Afterburner Expert gets two +1/+1 counters (6/4).

variants.label: already_activated
variants.delta: The exhaust ability was already activated on an earlier turn.
variants.expected: Activating the exhaust ability is not legal, even with four untapped Forests.

operation.unclassifiable: history: Afterburner Expert's exhaust ability was activated on an earlier turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge tracks the Exhaust$ True parameter with an activation limit on the ability; the earlier activation needs puzzle-style setup.

detector.outcome: A candidate activated ability limited to one activation passes the activation-limit check while it has not yet been activated.
detector.near_miss: An ability limited to one activation that was already activated fails the activation-limit check and is not playable.

scenarios.title: An effect that allows reactivation applies only before any exhaust ability has been activated this turn

setup.notes: Elvish Refueler's exhaust ability was already activated on an earlier turn. Afterburner Expert's was not.

decisions: A, with priority in the main phase and no exhaust ability activated yet this turn, considers activating Elvish Refueler's exhaust ability {1}{G}.

variants.label: none_activated_yet
variants.expected: Activating Elvish Refueler's exhaust ability is legal: its static ability lets A activate it as though it had not been activated, because no exhaust ability has been activated this turn.

variants.label: expert_activated_first
variants.delta: Earlier this turn A activated Afterburner Expert's exhaust ability {2}{G}{G} (tapping four Forests), and it resolved.
variants.expected: Activating Elvish Refueler's exhaust ability is not legal, even with two untapped Forests: an exhaust ability has already been activated this turn, so the static ability no longer applies.

operation.unclassifiable: history: Afterburner Expert's exhaust ability was activated earlier this turn.

detector.outcome: An already-used activate-only-once ability passes the activation-limit check because an effect lets it be activated again while no such ability has been activated this turn.
detector.near_miss: The permitting effect's condition is unmet (such an ability was already activated this turn), so the already-used ability fails the activation-limit check.
